privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Lumina Influence AI collects, why it collects it, and what you can do about it. It covers the web platform and the Instagram, YouTube and TikTok integrations. Questions: {{email}}.

sections.p: Lumina Influence AI is operated by K13 WEB, which is responsible for the processing described here. To exercise any right under this policy, write to {{email}}.

Account data: name, work email, role within the agency, and the identifier returned by your login provider (Google or Microsoft). We never receive or store your password for those providers.
Usage data: pages visited, campaigns and reports created, and technical error logs. Used to operate and debug the service.
Data from the social accounts you connect: the professional profile's identifier and username, follower count, and recent posts with caption, date, thumbnail, media type and performance metrics (reach, views, likes, comments, shares and saves). We also collect a sample of each post's public comments, including the commenter's username.
Access tokens: stored encrypted and used only for the calls described in this policy.

We use the data to build the performance dashboard, compare creators within a campaign, generate diagnostics, and produce the PDF reports you export. None of these uses involves selling data or targeted advertising.
We do not use collected data to train artificial intelligence models, and we do not allow our vendors to do so.

Platform diagnostics are produced by Google's Gemini model, acting as a data processor. We send it the caption text, the post's metrics and the comment sample; when an audit includes video analysis, the file is uploaded, processed and deleted from Google's service once the analysis ends.
The analysis is an automated reading and can be wrong. It does not replace human judgement and is not used to make automated decisions about people.

Account and usage data are processed to perform the service agreement (Brazil's LGPD, art. 7, V). Collection from social platforms happens under your explicit consent, given on each platform's own authorization screen (LGPD, art. 7, I), and can be withdrawn at any time — see section 8.
For users in the European Economic Area, the corresponding bases are performance of a contract and consent under the GDPR.

We do not sell, rent or trade personal data. We share it only with the vendors the service needs in order to run: Google (authentication and AI analysis), Microsoft (authentication), and the managed database provider that hosts the application. Each processes the data only on our instructions.
We may disclose information when required by a court order or legal obligation.

Account data and content you create are kept while the account exists. Metrics and comments collected from the platforms are kept while the account remains registered: disconnecting a network stops collection and erases the token, but preserves the history already collected, so that turning collection off does not erase the analysis work along with it. To erase that history too, just ask — the path is on the data deletion page.
Technical error logs are discarded within 90 days. Expired access tokens are removed automatically by the platform's cleanup job.

sections.h: 8. Your rights and how to exercise them
sections.p:
You may confirm that processing exists, and access, correct, anonymize, port or erase your data, as well as withdraw the consent given to the social platforms.
Disconnecting a social network is done in the platform itself and stops collection at once. Erasing data already collected is done by request to {{email}}, answered within 15 days. Step-by-step instructions for both are on the data deletion page.
You can also revoke Lumina's access from your Facebook, Instagram, Google or TikTok settings — collection stops immediately in that case.

All traffic uses HTTPS. Access tokens are encrypted at rest with a key managed outside the database. Access to data inside the platform is scoped to the agency the user belongs to, and that separation is checked by automated tests on every change.
No system is immune. If an incident poses a relevant risk, we notify the affected people and the competent authority.
Lumina Influence AI is a professional tool and is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children or teenagers; if we identify such an account, it is removed.
Material changes are announced in the platform before taking effect, and the update date at the top of this page is always revised.
Privacy questions, requests and complaints: {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Lumina Influence AI platform. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to them. Questions: {{email}}.

sections.p: It is an influencer marketing auditing platform: it gathers metrics from the accounts you connect, compares creators within a campaign, generates AI-assisted diagnostics, and exports reports.
The service is intended for agencies, brands and professionals aged 18 or over. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for everything done with them.

By connecting an Instagram, YouTube or TikTok account, you confirm that you are authorized by the profile owner to do so. Collection is limited to the permissions granted on the platform's authorization screen and follows each platform's own terms.
You can disconnect at any time, either in the platform or from the social network's own settings.

You may not use the platform to violate third-party rights, work around API technical limits, resell access, extract data in bulk for another purpose, or submit unlawful content.
We may suspend accounts that compromise service stability or breach the terms of the connected platforms.

sections.h: 5. Limits of the metrics and the analysis
sections.p:
The metrics shown are the ones each platform returns through its API, and may differ from the numbers seen in the native app because of window and definition differences — Instagram's move from "impressions" to "views" is one example.
The split between organic and paid reach is not measured by Instagram's public API; in demonstration environments it comes from sample data and is labelled as such.
AI-generated diagnostics are decision support, not a guarantee of results. You remain responsible for the business decisions you make from them.

The Lumina Influence AI software, brand and design belong to K13 WEB. The content you enter and the data collected from your accounts remain yours; you grant us only the licence needed to operate the service.

Available features, usage limits and prices are the ones stated on the plans page at the time of purchase. Price changes are announced in advance and do not apply retroactively to a cycle already paid.

We work to keep the service available, but it depends on third-party APIs that may change, throttle requests or go down. We do not guarantee uninterrupted operation.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount paid for the service in the 12 months preceding the event.
You may close your account at any time; data deletion follows the Privacy Policy. We may terminate accounts that breach these terms, with prior notice whenever possible.
These terms are governed by Brazilian law, with the user's domicile as the venue for any dispute.
Questions about these terms: {{email}}.

deletion.title: Data deletion
deletion.intro: This page explains how to erase the data Lumina Influence AI holds about you and about the social accounts you connected. Disconnecting stops collection; to erase what was already collected, use the request described in section 3. Every deletion is permanent — there is no recycle bin.

sections.p:
Erases the stored access token and immediately stops any further collection from that account. Posts and comments already collected remain — disconnection preserves the history on purpose, so that turning collection off does not erase the analysis work along with it. To erase what was already collected as well, use the email request in section 3.
Path: sign in, open Influencers, pick the creator, and in the "Connected accounts" card on the Overview tab use Disconnect on the network you want.

sections.h: 2. Revoke access from the social network itself
sections.p:
You can cut Lumina's access without signing in to the platform:
Facebook and Instagram: Settings & privacy, Settings, Apps and websites, select Lumina Influence AI and remove.
Google and YouTube: myaccount.google.com/permissions, select Lumina Influence AI and remove access.
TikTok: Settings, Security and permissions, Manage app permissions.
Revoking stops collection immediately. To erase what was already collected, use section 3.

This is the path that actually erases: write to {{email}} saying what you want deleted — one social account and the posts collected from it, an entire creator, or your user account and all of the agency's data.
We verify identity before acting and answer within 15 days, as required by Brazil's LGPD. Deletion is permanent: there is no recycle bin, and the data cannot be recovered afterwards.
Deleting a creator also removes every connected account, post, comment and generated analysis. Deleting the account of the agency's only administrator also removes the agency's data: creators, campaigns, reports and all collected history.

Technical error logs, which hold no post content, are discarded within 90 days by the cleanup job. Data we are legally required to retain — tax records, for example — is kept only for the statutory period and used for no other purpose.
